title: Kunst und Ausdruck
welcome_lead: Human Ingenuity in German covers art, music, literature. From Bauhaus to Beethoven, the heritage is vast.
meta_desc: German: art, music, expression, Bauhaus, German artists.
final_note: Kunst braucht Sprache — to discuss it extends it.

walkthroughs.body_html: Im Vordergrund / im Hintergrund. Der Maler verwendet kraftige Farben. Das Bild vermittelt Stimmung.
Founded by Walter Gropius in Weimar, 1919. Form folgt Funktion — its central principle. Closed by Nazis in 1933.
Discuss Hat Kunst eine politische Aufgabe?. Use zwar. aber. for balanced argument.

sequence.def: Um 1800: Caspar David Friedrich's moonlit landscapes
Ab etwa 1850: everyday life painted truthfully
Ab 1905: Die Brücke's raw colour in Dresden
Ab 1916: anti-art protest during the war
1919–1933: form follows function, Weimar and Dessau
